scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @cashpilot/api" "npm run dev -w @cashpilot/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cashpilot/api && npm run build -w @cashpilot/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cashpilot/api && npm run typecheck -w @cashpilot/web
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
